mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an easing monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines over the prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months, it indicates labor market deterioration that triggers defensive sector rotation and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains negative over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and rising consumer inflation (CPIAUCSL) signal stagflation risk that increases equity valuation uncertainty, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where HOUST declines and CPIAUCSL rises, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion (INDPRO > 110.0), strong industrial production growth supports corporate earnings momentum, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 110.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%) signals imminent monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 2.5%, or Rank IC remains negative over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When residential investment (RSAFS) falls below 500,000 million dollars for two consecutive months, it indicates housing market contraction that reduces consumer confidence and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where RSAFS falls below 500,000 million dollars for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (UNRATE < 3.5%), a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals economic slowdown that triggers equity sell-offs, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS declines, or Rank IC remains negative over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained industrial production growth (INDPRO > 105.0) indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO exceeds 105.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
